title: Clean data hand-off to metafor/RevMan
context: Systematic-Review-Assist explicitly does not perform statistical meta-analysis; that is left to established tools (R metafor, RevMan, etc.). Once data extraction and risk-of-bias assessment are complete, reviewers need to hand off the extraction dataset in a format compatible with their statistical tool of choice. This task adds export adapters for clean data hand-off. No statistics are computed in-tool. The task is backlog because the core pipeline must be validated first.
objective: Implement export adapters in @hee-lee-oss/sra-core for clean data hand-off to R metafor and RevMan: produce a metafor-compatible CSV (with column naming aligned to metafor's effect-size functions) and a RevMan-compatible XML or CSV export from the committed extraction dataset; no statistical calculations are performed in-tool; each export includes the per-output licence + attribution manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: A metafor-compatible CSV export is generated from the committed extraction dataset with column naming and structure aligned to metafor's standard effect-size input format (documented with a reference to the metafor documentation)
A RevMan-compatible export (XML or CSV as RevMan accepts) is generated from the committed extraction dataset; the format is documented with a reference to the RevMan import specification

No statistical calculations are performed in-tool: the exports contain only the extracted and human-verified values from the project store; any computation (pooled effects, heterogeneity, forest plots) is left to the downstream tool
Each export is accompanied by the per-output licence + attribution manifest (from task 015); the manifest lists the source review, the extraction dataset version, and the applicable licences
Tests cover: metafor CSV round-trip (known input → expected output), RevMan export round-trip, and licence manifest inclusion; all run in CI; pnpm build && pnpm test pass
output: A merged PR adding metafor-compatible CSV and RevMan-compatible export adapters to @hee-lee-oss/sra-core, with per-output licence manifests, no in-tool statistics, and a test suite covering both export formats.
